hook: Sony Music Entertainment is facing a nearly $1.25 million royalty lawsuit.

sections.voiceover: Sony Music Entertainment is facing a nearly $1.25 million royalty lawsuit.

Montague filed this federal lawsuit in New York on October 16, 2026, against Sony Music. He co-produced the Chris Brown single Party featuring Usher and Gucci Mane. Montague alleges Sony Music Entertainment paid him only 1.5 percent instead of 3 percent royalties.
Montague claims Sony Music Entertainment paid him only half of his agreed royalty rate.
He now demands $1.25 million from Sony Music Entertainment in New York federal court.
The $1.25 million claim remains unresolved in federal court.
